name: Water Forget-me-not
desc: Water Forget-me-not (Myosotis scorpioides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Myosotis scorpioides, the true forget-me-not or water forget-me-not, is a forget-me-not plant species in the borage family, Boraginaceae.
